segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, Circle Inversion is the conformal radial reflection across a circle of radius R. A point P at distance d from the center O maps to a point P prime along the same ray O P at distance R squared over d, so that the product of their radial distances equals R squared.
